obsbot.connected.description: Runs when Cuebot starts talking to OBSBOT Center (the OBSBOT camera app) or to your OBSBOT camera.

obsbot.disconnected.description: Runs when Cuebot loses contact with OBSBOT Center or the camera.

variables.reason: A short text saying why contact was lost

obsbot.deviceChanged.description: Runs when a different camera gets selected in OBSBOT Center. Only matters if you have more than one OBSBOT camera.

variables.obsbot.deviceIndex: Which camera is selected, counting from 0 (0 is the first camera)

obsbot.sleepStateChanged.description: Runs when the camera goes to sleep or wakes up.

fields.stateFilter: Choose Awake to react only when the camera wakes up, Asleep only when it goes to sleep, or Any for both.

variables.obsbot.awake: True when the camera is awake

obsbot.zoomChanged.description: Runs when the camera's zoom or field of view changes, whether from Cuebot, OBSBOT Center or the camera itself.

obsbot.gimbalMoved.description: Runs when the camera turns or tilts to a new position.

variables.obsbot.pitch: How far the camera is tilted up or down, in degrees
variables.obsbot.yaw: How far the camera is turned left or right, in degrees

obsbot.aiTrackingChanged.description: Runs when AI tracking locks onto a subject or lets go of it.

fields.stateFilter: Choose Locked to react only when it locks on, Unlocked only when it lets go, or Any for both.

variables.obsbot.aiLocked: True when AI tracking is locked on a subject

obsbot.message.description: For experts: runs when OBSBOT sends a message that Cuebot does not turn into one of the other triggers. Useful for commands this app has no trigger for.

fields.address: Only react to this message address, like "/OBSBOT/WebCam/General/SetZoom". Separate several with commas. Leave empty to react to every such message.

variables.obsbot.arg0: The first value in the message
variables.obsbot.args: All the values as one list

obsbot.selectDevice.description: Picks which OBSBOT camera the next steps control. Only needed if you have more than one camera.

fields.device: The camera number, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them.

obsbot.wakeSleep.description: Wakes the camera up or puts it to sleep. Handy to switch the camera off when you end your stream.

fields.state: Wake wakes it, Sleep puts it to sleep, Toggle flips the current state.
fields.device: Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center.

variables.obsbot.awake: True when the camera is awake now

obsbot.resetGimbal.description: Turns the camera back to its centre position.

fields.device: Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center.

obsbot.setZoom.description: Zooms the camera to a set amount.

fields.zoom: How far to zoom, from 0 (widest) to 100 (closest).
fields.speed: How fast to zoom, 0 to 11 (higher is faster, 0 is the normal speed). Leave empty to jump straight there. Only newer cameras support it.
fields.device: Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center.

obsbot.zoomLimit.description: Zooms the camera all the way in or all the way out.

fields.limit: Max zooms all the way in. Min zooms all the way out.
fields.device: Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center.

obsbot.moveGimbal.description: Turns or tilts the camera in a direction, like moving it by hand. Choose Stop to stop it.

fields.direction: Which way to move. Choose Stop to stop all movement.
fields.speed: How fast to move, from 1 (slow) to 100 (fast).
fields.duration: How long to move, in milliseconds (1000 is one second). Leave empty to keep moving until you run a Stop step.
fields.device: Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center.

obsbot.setGimbalPosition.description: Turns the camera to an exact left-right and up-down angle.

fields.pan: How far to turn left or right, in degrees. 0 is the middle, minus is left. About -129 to 129; a Tail 2 connected straight to Cuebot allows -159 to 159.
fields.pitch: How far to tilt up or down, in degrees. 0 is level. About -59 to 59; a Tail 2 connected straight to Cuebot allows -62 to 62.
fields.speed: How fast to turn, from 0 to 90.
fields.precise: Tick to send angles with decimals, like 12.5, instead of whole degrees. Works only through OBSBOT Center.
fields.device: Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center.

obsbot.setView.description: Changes how wide the camera sees (its field of view). A bigger angle shows more of the room.

fields.device: Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center.

obsbot.setMirror.description: Flips the picture left to right, like a mirror.

fields.state: On flips the picture. Off shows it the normal way round.
fields.device: Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center.

obsbot.recording.description: Starts or stops a recording made by the camera or by OBSBOT Center.

fields.target: PC recording and High-fps recording are made on your computer. Camera recording is made by the camera itself and only works on a Tail camera.
fields.state: Start begins recording, Stop ends it.
fields.device: Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center.

obsbot.snapshot.description: Takes a still photo with the camera.

fields.target: PC snapshot is taken on your computer. Camera snapshot is taken by the camera itself and only works on a Tail camera.
fields.device: Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center.

obsbot.setImage.description: Changes one picture setting of the camera, such as focus, exposure or white balance (the colour warmth).

fields.value: The new value. Auto settings: 1 is auto, 0 is manual. Manual focus: 0-100. Exposure compensation: -30 to 30. ISO: 100-6400. Color temperature: 2000-10000. Shutter speed: like 100 for 1/100.
fields.value2: Only for Tail focus mode, White balance shift and Red/blue gain, which need two numbers. Leave empty for the others.
fields.device: Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center.

obsbot.aiLock.description: Locks AI tracking onto the subject now in view, or lets go again. For Tiny cameras.

fields.state: Lock keeps following the current subject. Unlock lets the camera choose again. Toggle flips the current state.
fields.device: Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center.

variables.obsbot.aiLocked: True when tracking is locked now

obsbot.triggerPreset.description: Moves the camera to one of its three saved positions (presets).

fields.preset: Which saved position to go to: 1, 2 or 3.
fields.series: Your camera model family: Tiny or Tail. Auto works it out from the camera's name or from the OBSBOT card's setting. Pick one yourself if Auto guesses wrong.
fields.device: Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center.

obsbot.setAiMode.description: Chooses what the camera's AI follows, like the whole body or just the face.

fields.mode: A mode number. For Tiny 2: 0 off, 1 normal, 2 upper body, 3 close-up, 4 headless, 5 lower body, 6 desk, 7 whiteboard, 8 hand, 9 group. Other models use other numbers.
fields.series: Your camera model family: Tiny or Tail. Auto works it out from the camera's name or from the OBSBOT card's setting. Pick one yourself if Auto guesses wrong.
fields.device: Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center.

obsbot.setTrackingMode.description: Chooses how a Tiny camera follows you: Headroom keeps space above your head, Standard follows you, Motion follows movement.

fields.mode: Headroom, Standard or Motion. Tiny 2, Tiny 2 Lite and Tiny SE only have Standard and Motion.
fields.device: Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center.

obsbot.setTrackingSpeed.description: Sets how quickly the camera follows you.

fields.speed: A number. Tiny 3 and Tail Air: 0 slow, 1 standard, 2 fast. Tail 2: 0 to 5, from very lazy to automatic. For one axis on a Tail 2: 1 to 10.
fields.axis: Both changes everything at once. Pan is left-right and Tilt is up-down; picking one is only for the Tail 2.
fields.series: Your camera model family: Tiny or Tail. Auto works it out from the camera's name or from the OBSBOT card's setting. Pick one yourself if Auto guesses wrong.
fields.device: Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center.

obsbot.setAxisLock.description: Locks the Tail 2 so it cannot turn left-right (Pan) or up-down (Tilt), or lets it move again.

fields.axis: Pan is left and right. Tilt is up and down.
fields.state: Lock stops it from moving that way. Unlock lets it move again.
fields.device: Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center.

obsbot.setVirtualBackground.description: Changes the background behind you without a green screen. For OBSBOT Meet cameras.

fields.mode: Disable shows your real room. Blur blurs what is behind you. Green screen and Replacement are the camera's other background modes; set their look in OBSBOT Center.
fields.device: Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center.

obsbot.setAutoFraming.description: Makes the camera crop and follow people on its own. For OBSBOT Meet cameras.

fields.mode: Disable turns it off. Single follows one person. Group fits everyone in the picture.
fields.device: Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center.

obsbot.standardMode.description: Switches an OBSBOT Meet camera to its standard mode.

fields.device: Which camera, from 1 to 4, in the order OBSBOT Center lists them. Leave empty to use the camera that is selected in OBSBOT Center.

obsbot.getState.description: Reads the camera's current zoom, angle, AI lock and more into variables you can use in later steps.

variables.obsbot.deviceIndex: Which camera is selected, counting from 0 (0 is the first camera)
variables.obsbot.awake: True when the camera is awake
variables.obsbot.pitch: How far the camera is tilted up or down, in degrees
variables.obsbot.yaw: How far the camera is turned left or right, in degrees
variables.obsbot.aiLocked: True when AI tracking is locked on a subject
variables.obsbot.fov: The field of view as a number (0 is 86°, 1 is 78°, 2 is 65°)
variables.obsbot.isConnected: True when Cuebot is connected to OBSBOT Center

obsbot.sendOsc.description: For experts: sends your own OSC message (a short control message that OBSBOT understands). Use it for camera features the other steps do not cover.

fields.address: The message address, like /OBSBOT/WebCam/General/SetZoom. See OBSBOT's own OSC list for the addresses.
fields.args: The values for the message, separated by spaces or commas, like "50". Whole numbers, decimals, true/false and words are all fine. Leave empty if it needs none.
